description: Hand-calculated fixtures. Matching uses input order; indexes are zero-based event rows (excluding the CSV header). Input id equals its index. All three queries use SELECT ALL and CONSUME BY NONE.

cases.explanation: Each of two A events can pair with each of two B events and the final C; N is skipped.
Only A index 1 has value > 5, only B index 4 has value > 8, and the final C has value > 5.
For each A, B+ selects either single B or both B events in order before the final C.
